So (n−2)·180 = 1070 + x, which means 1070 < (n−2)·180 < 1250.
Dividing by 180: 5.94 < n−2 < 6.94, so n−2 = 6 and n = 8.

Check: the total is 1080°, so x = 10°, which is valid. This gives n = 8.
